title: United States announces 1.85 billion dollar aid package including a Patriot battery for Ukraine
body:
On Wednesday, 21 December 2022, the United States announced a new military aid package for Ukraine worth 1.85 billion dollars, including 1 billion dollars in weapons and equipment drawn from Pentagon stocks and 850 million dollars through the Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative. It was the 28th Pentagon drawdown for Ukraine. The announcement came as President Volodymyr Zelensky travelled to Washington.

The package included the first Patriot battery sent to Ukraine, the most advanced surface-to-air missile system the West had provided. US troops were to train Ukrainian forces on it at the Grafenwoehr training area in Germany, a process that could take several weeks. The package also contained more HIMARS rockets, 500 precision-guided artillery rounds, 30 mortar systems with 10,000 mortar rounds, 37 MRAP vehicles, 120 Humvees, more than 2,700 grenade launchers, an undisclosed number of HARM missiles and JDAM kits, and satellite communications terminals and services.

The Associated Press reported that Russia's Foreign Ministry warned that the Patriot delivery would be provocative and that the system and its crews could be legitimate targets. Total US military aid since 24 February 2022 stood at about 21.3 billion dollars.
